import json
import requests
import sys

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        print("Usage: python feed_digest.py <config_file>")
        return

    config_file = sys.argv[1]
    with open(config_file, 'r') as f:
        config = json.load(f)

    results = []
    for feed in config.get('feeds', []):
        name = feed.get('name')
        url = feed.get('url')
        try:
            response = requests.get(url)
            response.raise_for_status()
            content_type = response.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
            if 'xml' in content_type:
                xml_content = response.text
                if '<item>' in xml_content:
                    start_item = xml_content.index('<item>')
                    end_item = xml_content.index('</item>', start_item) + len('</item>')
                    item_content = xml_content[start_item:end_item]
                    title_start = item_content.index('<title>') + len('<title>')
                    title_end = item_content.index('</title>', title_start)
                    link_start = item_content.index('<link>') + len('<link>')
                    link_end = item_content.index('</link>', link_start)
                    title = item_content[title_start:title_end]
                    link = item_content[link_start:link_end]
                    results.append({"name": name, "title": title, "link": link})
                else:
                    results.append({"name": name, "error": "failed"})
            else:
                results.append({"name": name, "error": "failed"})
        except Exception:
            results.append({"name": name, "error": "failed"})

    output = {"feeds": results}
    print(json.dumps(output, indent=2))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
